answer: An operator bonds 30 POA for fifteen epochs and must finish five separate jobs, each audited by three randomly selected reviewers who share no funding source. Two matching approvals pass a job; confirmed collusion burns 20% of the bond. The ledger is public: a mesa of level tenure shows sustained work, an opal certificate cannot be reused across accounts, and a glacier of slow reputation makes burst farming uneconomical. Every sybil identity needs its own bond, jobs, and independent reviewers, so mass cloning loses money.
